messages:
tess.sales: hey team, need an urgent ask for an enterprise prospect. they want temporary access to SOC 2 evidence for a week to complete their vendor risk review. deadline EOD Thu. can we provide a bridge letter + presigned evidence bundle? they also asked for a CAIQ summary.

matt.se: pinging security/legal — can we do a timeboxed presigned s3 bucket with redacted artifacts? customer is doing a POC and needs to validate controls quickly.

zoe.security: we can provide a scoped snapshot (system configuration, control descriptions, selected test evidence). we need to know exact controls they require and whether a redaction is ok. full report is under NDA only.

leah.legal: @tess.sales quick Qs: who is the signee on customer side? do we have an executed NDA? if not we can use our standard short-form bridge + limited access addendum. we will need name/email to lock presign policy.

ops.jo: from ops: presign window we can do 72 hours by default, max 7 days with approval. prefer to create per-object presigned links instead of open bucket. give me the list of files or prefix and i'll generate links. sample command i’ll run: `presign --expiry 72h s3://evidence/redwood-prod/tony-poc/`

tess.sales: customer contact is Tony (tony@everbridge.com). NDA not signed yet — they said they'd sign if we can show evidence. they specifically asked for SOC 2 type II report excerpts for CC6, CC7, CC8 and the CAIQ high-level mapping. deadline is 48 hours.

zoe.security: CC6/7/8 are fine to include in snapshot. we'll redact account identifiers and any third-party customer data. CAIQ summary: we can provide a one-page mapping to our controls. i’ll prepare a short pack.

leah.legal: ok pushing a bridge-letter + access addendum draft to the thread. if Tony signs, we can approve a 7-day presign for reviewed items. attaching template: https://drive.redwood/reports/bridge-template-v2.docx

upload-bot: draft bridge letter uploaded by leah.legal: https://drive.redwood/reports/bridge-template-v2.docx (sha256: e3b0c442...)

ops.jo: @zoe.security once you list the file prefixes i'll create presigned urls. also will set IP allowlist from Tony's office if required.

tess.sales: thanks — Zoe will list files by EOD. Leah, i'll route the bridge to Tony and cc legal. Matt, can you confirm pricing impact if we extend demo access with logs?

matt.se: pricing note: transient access for proof-of-evidence doesn't change committed terms. if they require extended access we can discuss protected demo seats. for now no change.

zoe.security: file list (redacted names):
- /evidence/soc2/2024/excerpts/CC6_control_tests.pdf
- /evidence/soc2/2024/excerpts/CC7_control_tests.pdf
- /evidence/soc2/2024/excerpts/CC8_control_tests.pdf
- /evidence/caix_mapping/caiaq-summary-1p.pdf
- /evidence/configs/host-hardening-snapshot-2024-09.tar.gz

ops.jo: creating presigned links now with expiry 7 days pending legal sign-off. will post links and one-time tokens in DM to Tony after NDA.

upload-bot: presigned urls created (expires in 7 days) for prefix `/evidence/soc2/2024/excerpts/` and configs. links DM'ed to leah.legal.

leah.legal: sent bridge + access addendum to Tony (tony@everbridge.com). requested counter-sign by EOD Thu. once signed, ops please confirm link delivery method.

tess.sales: appreciated. if Tony signs, i’ll confirm POC kickoff. keep me posted on any blocker. :thumbsup:

zoe.security: FYI i've redlined one control test that references third-party data; will provide a redacted copy by EOD.

matt.se: thanks all — i’ll stand by for signed NDA. if the customer insists on raw logs we should flag that as a blocker (needs additional approval).

leah.legal: noted. if they ask for raw logs include a specific justification and we’ll evaluate. for now proceed with excerpts and CAIQ.

ops.jo: final note — audit trail will record all presign downloads and we’ll provide usage logs to security/legal after the window closes.

tess.sales: perfect. tagging this as urgent follow-up. will update thread when Tony countersigns or we hear back.

matt.se: :eyes:
